# Navigation Live Activity and reliable location delivery (2026-08-25 18:41Z)

_**User**_

Requested a Navigation Live Activity that starts when an active Miataru route enters the background, remains current with distance and ETA, opens the matching navigation when tapped, shows turn guidance during focused double-tap navigation, and shows the remote device's place during standard navigation.

The user also required failed location updates to remain queued, a gated cached-location startup heartbeat, restoration of the previous background-tracking behavior when no navigation is active, complete changelog history, and the established test/archive/App Store Connect release workflow.

---

_**Agent**_

Implemented shared ActivityKit attributes, a testable single-activity coordinator, Lock Screen and Dynamic Island UI, localized stale-state presentation, idempotent navigation deep links, app lifecycle reconciliation, route snapshot publication, and privacy-gated high-accuracy background navigation.

Extended focused navigation Activities with the current MapKit maneuver, symbol, and maneuver distance. Standard navigation Activities show the latest cached reverse-geocoded locality and country.

Observed ActivityKit lifecycle updates so ended or dismissed Activities immediately release their high-accuracy `CLBackgroundActivitySession`, stop the secondary frequent location manager and blue background-location indicator, return to the previous Significant-Change/Smart/manual frequent policy, and are not recreated for the same navigation.

Preserved unsuccessful location uploads in FIFO order for all delivery failures and added a once-per-process startup heartbeat gated by enabled reporting, an unpaused state, a valid cached location, and a last successful upload at least three hours old. Heartbeats do not create server history points.

Updated all affected tests, test documentation, Widget localizations, project metadata, and `CHANGELOG.md`, including missing 3.3.3 through 3.3.5 release history.

Verification completed on the dedicated `miataru Tests - iPhone 16` simulator:

- Navigation Live Activity and location-policy focus: 27 tests in 2 suites passed.
- Full unit target: 338 tests in 36 suites passed.
- All `.xcstrings` passed `jq empty`.
- Project and Info plists passed `plutil -lint`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- App and widget archived as version 3.4 build 4 with valid signatures.
- Build 4 was accepted by App Store Connect and entered Apple processing.

Physical-device verification of Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, continuous background cadence, and immediate disappearance of the blue location indicator remains manual.
